{{Quote|Dendriton toxin is a bad way to go. Painful, slow&mdash;you're literally immolated from inside out. But you were a brave adversary, Admiral, and I admire bravery. So, even though my superiors wish you to suffer, I'll spare you the toxin's effects.|The Nediji assassin Kaird kills Admiral Tarnese Bleyd|<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
'''Dendriton toxin''' was a type of poison to which members of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were susceptible. Soon after exposure, the toxin caused fatigue and lethargy. It then manifest as numbness, eventually leading to intense muscle pain and total paralysis. The [[Nediji]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kaird]] laced his [[Knife/Legends|knife]] with dentriton toxin before a fight with the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]]. After a cut to his [[Limb/Legends|hand]], Tarnese succumbed to the effects of the toxin, allowing the Nediji to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.
